purpose: Retrieve source-backed construction knowledge by category and direction, bind explicit goals to installed blueprints, execute ordinary capabilities, and retain rechecked construction experience.

properties.operation: summary, query, get, closure, plan, build or experience
properties.intent: purpose, exact direction, explicit goals, typed parameters and optional blueprint id; parameters can select atlas data
properties.memory: optional caller-selected persistent experience directory outside machine internals
properties.plan_sha256: optional expected plan identity; changed source, parameters or experience returns HOLD before writes

contains: retained intent, construction, results and goal checks

limitations: An index record is not proof of execution. Descriptor resources and research anatomy remain explicitly unverified.
Direction and goals are explicit contracts; arbitrary prose does not acquire invented semantics or a quality score.
Categories and blueprint compositions are extensible. Execution needs installed capabilities and bounded input contracts.
Experience preserves success and failure. Search seeds are measured again; observations never silently become canon or new capabilities.
